verdict.rationale: x402 lets AI agents pay merchants directly. A server returns HTTP 402, the agent signs a stablecoin payment and retries, and the CDP Facilitator verifies and settles it. Merchant checkouts built on Payment Acceptance can be x402-enabled so agents authorize payment sessions, and MCP-compatible agents can discover sellers through the Bazaar MCP server and pay from agentic wallets. However, the documented use is mainly per-request API and resource payment by developer-built agents, not consumer product purchases inside named chat assistants. missing for 10: documented checkout inside ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Copilot surfaces, consumer-facing in-chat purchase flow for physical/catalog products, fiat/card payment options beyond crypto rails, hands-on corroboration of in-assistant purchases.
